hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: For G0002, substitute z=x into F to obtain F(x)=f(x); for G0003, substitute z=y into F to obtain F(y)=f(y); for G0001, apply the first divided difference operator to F at nodes x and y: (F(x)-F(y))/(x-y).
required_assumptions: F is defined at the nodes x and y
x != y for the divided difference G0001

proof_obligations.expected: member == F(z) with z=x, i.e. f(x) == F(x)
member == F(z) with z=y, i.e. f(y) == F(y)

hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The three catalog expressions are structurally related by one latent univariate function f evaluated at two distinct nodes and by the first divided difference of that latent function. This is a divided-difference family in which the two evaluations are instances and the quotient is the Newton divided-difference member.
